title: 第5章 开除？

content_zh:
医务室距离体育馆很近，但几个白大褂能力有限，处理一些发烧小感冒还行，但这种钝器造成的重伤却没辙。
进行一番抢救后，楚惜颜被火速送往校外的大医院。
宁小凡想跟过去，却被楚家的保镖给拦下来了。
他想了想，楚家那么有钱，应该问题不大。
第二天。
一大早的，班主任刘蓉劈头盖脸就是一顿臭骂，然后让他滚去会议室。
会议室中间有一张红楠木长桌，围坐着几个校方大佬。
“经过校方慎重考虑，宁小凡同学，我们决定给予你……开除处分。”
校长室内，一个半秃顶、身材较矮的中年人阴沉地看着宁小凡，他就是清江一中的校长，朱东强。
此次事件太恶劣了！
朱东强恨不得把宁小凡大卸八块。
楚惜颜昏迷不醒，顾家差点断子绝孙，不仅导致校董顾国豪为体育馆铺新地板的计划泡汤，更是惹怒了楚家。
而罪魁祸首，就是这个来自贫民窟的穷学生！
站在会议桌前，冷漠的声音盘旋在耳畔，宁小凡怀疑自己是不是听错了。
明明是顾天宇寻衅滋事，开除的却是他？
“为什么？我不懂。”
宁小凡深吸一口气，目光有些颤抖。
“宁小凡……你还有脸问为什么？！”
身材肥硕、浓妆艳抹的刘蓉从位子上站起，尖锐的指甲几乎要戳到宁小凡鼻子。
刘蓉咬牙怒视着宁小凡，“你纠集一帮社会混混，殴打优等生顾天宇，导致重伤。楚惜颜也被你打成重度脑震荡……你这种人渣，还有脸问为什么？”

“你胡说！”宁小凡怒火中烧。
“请注意你的言辞！宁小凡同学，这里是校长室，你最好收起你肆意妄为的性子！”
朱东强用指节敲了敲楠木桌子，拔高音量。
“哼，没教养的农民工！”刘蓉愤愤不平地坐下来。
“我们一中是全清江最好的学校，培养的都是社会精英，这种垃圾啊，早该开除了。”一个戴着细框眼镜，娘娘腔的男老师说道。
“校长做的是明智之选！”
“我们清江一中容不下这种社会渣滓！”
顿时，教导主任、副校长和德育处主任七嘴八舌，言语之恶毒，令宁小凡紧攥拳头，指甲深深刺入掌心。
“宁小凡是吧？”
忽然，一道嚣张的声音传来。
众人看去，只见一个戴着墨镜、西装革履的中年男人大步走进校长室，眼神犹如虎狼。
“顾董！”
朱东强大惊失色，连忙迎了上来，脸上堆满了笑容。
“小李，快快！把我那壶极品碧螺春拿出来！”朱东强赶忙招呼。
“好咧！”
娘娘腔的李老师翘起兰花指，满脸谄媚之色。
“顾国豪……原来如此。”
宁小凡的嘴角，蓦然浮现一抹苍凉的笑容。
盛辉告诉过他，顾天宇的老爸顾国豪，是清江一中校董之一，财力雄厚。校长什么的，只不过是他的打工仔。
顾国豪一进来，便姿态甚大地坐在沙发上，旁边的校长主任一个劲的端茶送水，捏腰捶腿。

“宁小凡，你一个卑贱的农民，垃圾一样的下等人，竟敢打我顾国豪的儿子，你想过后果没有？嗯？！”
顾国豪冷冷看着宁小凡，这目光，犹如在看一个下水道里蠕动的蛆虫。
“顾国豪！你好大的口气！”
就在宁小凡濒临暴走之际，门外又响起一道怒喝声。
“谁？”
顾国豪转脸望去，只见一个身材高大、脸庞犹如刀削斧凿的男人走进会议室，气势如山，一看就是常年身居高位的大佬。
“哼，亏你顾国豪还是盛世财团的董事长，做事竟然这么没有担当。”男人一脸鄙夷，极其不屑与之为伍。
“楚董事长！”
朱东强吓得一哆嗦，山海集团董事长，楚海山！
今天这是怎么了，两个身家数百亿的集团大佬，竟然齐聚一个小小的会议室？
“小李，快快，再给楚董泡一杯茶！”
“不必了！”
楚海山一挥手，怒气冲冲道：“我今天来，是要为我女儿讨个公道。朱校长，我想了解一下，惜颜究竟是怎么受伤的？”
“这个……呃……我昨天不在学校，具体情况也不太清楚……”
朱东强低着头，就跟一个犯了错误的孩子似的。
刘蓉咽了口唾沫，上前露出一个谄媚的笑容。
“呵呵，楚董，事情是这样的。昨天体育课，这个差生宁小凡纠集了一帮社会混混，围殴顾董的儿子顾天宇，结果误伤了令千金……”

content_en:
The infirmary is very close to the gymnasium, but the capabilities of the few white coats are limited. They can handle some fevers and minor colds, but they can't deal with serious injuries caused by such blunt instruments.
After some rescue work, Chu Xiyan was rushed to a large hospital outside the school.
Ning Xiaofan wanted to follow, but was stopped by the Chu family's bodyguards.
He thought for a while, since the Chu family was so rich, it shouldn't be a big problem.
the next day.
Early in the morning, the head teacher Liu Rong cursed him and told him to go to the conference room.
There is a long red nanmu table in the middle of the conference room, with several school bosses sitting around it.
"After careful consideration by the school, classmate Ning Xiaofan, we have decided to give you... expulsion."
In the principal's room, a semi-bald, short middle-aged man looked at Ning Xiaofan gloomily. He was Zhu Dongqiang, the principal of Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School.
This incident is so bad!
Zhu Dongqiang wanted to tear Ning Xiaofan into pieces.
Chu Xiyan was unconscious, and the Gu family was almost extinct. Not only did school director Gu Guohao's plan to lay a new floor for the gymnasium fail, but it also angered the Chu family.
And the culprit is this poor student from the slums!
Standing in front of the conference table, an indifferent voice hovered in his ears, and Ning Xiaofan wondered if he heard it wrong.
It was obviously Gu Tianyu who was causing trouble, but he was the one who was fired?
"Why? I don't understand."
Ning Xiaofan took a deep breath, his eyes trembling.
"Ning Xiaofan...you still have the nerve to ask why?!"
Liu Rong, who was fat and heavily made-up, stood up from her seat, her sharp nails almost poking Ning Xiaofan's nose.
Liu Rong gritted her teeth and glared at Ning Xiaofan, "You gathered a group of gangsters and beat the top student Gu Tianyu, causing serious injuries. You also beat Chu Xiyan to a severe concussion... How can a scum like you still have the nerve to ask why?"
"You're talking nonsense!" Ning Xiaofan was furious.
"Please watch your words! Classmate Ning Xiaofan, this is the principal's office. You'd better put aside your wanton temper!"
Zhu Dongqiang knocked on the nanmu table with his knuckles and turned up the volume.
"Huh, uneducated migrant workers!" Liu Rong sat down angrily.
"Our No. 1 Middle School is the best school in Qingjiang. It educates social elites. This kind of rubbish should have been expelled a long time ago." said an effeminate male teacher wearing thin-rimmed glasses.
"The principal made a wise choice!"
"Our Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School has no room for such social scum!"
Suddenly, the dean, the vice principal and the director of the Moral Education Department were all talking at once, and their words were so vicious that Ning Xiaofan clenched his fists and dug his nails deeply into his palms.
"Ning Xiaofan, right?"
Suddenly, an arrogant voice came.
When everyone looked around, they saw a middle-aged man wearing sunglasses, a suit and leather shoes striding into the principal's office, his eyes like those of a tiger and a wolf.
"Director Gu!"
Zhu Dongqiang was shocked and rushed towards him with a smile on his face.
"Xiao Li, hurry up! Take out my pot of the best Biluochun!" Zhu Dongqiang hurriedly greeted.
"Okay!"
The sissy Teacher Li raised her orchid fingers with a flattering look on her face.
"Gu Guohao...that's it."
A desolate smile suddenly appeared on the corner of Ning Xiaofan's mouth.
Sheng Hui told him that Gu Tianyu's father, Gu Guohao, was one of the directors of Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School and had strong financial resources. The principal and so on are just his wage earners.
As soon as Gu Guohao came in, he sat on the sofa with great posture. The principal and director next to him kept bringing tea and water, squeezing his waist and beating his legs.
"Ning Xiaofan, you are a lowly peasant and a low-class person like trash. How dare you hit my son, Gu Guohao? Have you thought about the consequences? Huh?!"
Gu Guohao looked at Ning Xiaofan coldly, as if looking at maggots squirming in the sewer.
"Gu Guohao! You have such a loud voice!"
Just when Ning Xiaofan was on the verge of going berserk, another angry shout sounded outside the door.
"Who?"
Gu Guohao turned around and saw a tall man with a face like a knife.The sharp-edged man walked into the conference room with a strong momentum. At first glance, he looked like a big boss who had been in high positions all year round.
"Humph, it's a shame that Gu Guohao is still the chairman of the Shengshi Consortium, but you are so irresponsible in your work." The man looked contemptuous and disdained to be associated with him.
"Chairman Chu!"
Zhu Dongqiang trembled with fright. Chairman of Shanhai Group, Chu Haishan!
What happened today? Two group bosses with tens of billions of dollars gathered in a small conference room?
"Xiao Li, hurry up and make another cup of tea for Mr. Chu!"
"No need!"
Chu Haishan waved his hand and said angrily: "I am here today to seek justice for my daughter. Principal Zhu, I want to know how Xiyan was injured?"
"Well... uh... I was not at school yesterday, and I don't know the specific situation..."
Zhu Dongqiang lowered his head, like a child who had made a mistake.
Liu Rong swallowed and stepped forward with a flattering smile.
"Haha, Director Chu, here's what happened. In yesterday's physical education class, this poor student Ning Xiaofan gathered a group of gangsters and beat up Director Gu's son Gu Tianyu, and accidentally injured Ling Qianjin..."
